title: Micron steps up HBM investment in Taiwan, Singapore
html:
Micron Technology is stepping up investment in high-bandwidth memory (HBM) production in Taiwan and Singapore as it seeks to narrow the capacity gap with South Korean rivals Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.
